notes: Machine-readable research-ethics + statistical-practice register. Maps each external standard the How2Vote research programme is run against — the ABS quality and confidentiality standards, the National Statement on Ethical Conduct in Human Research 2025, and (because Indigenous status IS collected) the AIATSIS Code of Ethics — to the CONTROL that implements it plus the CI test IDs and external-evidence IDs. It also records the invariants that make the research ethical-by-construction and are enforced in code: 'prefer not to say' is available on every sensitive item; research participation is never a condition of core use; and the sample-size / non-representativeness warnings shown on Insights. The ethics determination and the Indigenous data-governance decision cannot be produced by code — they are held in the restricted legal records and referenced by evidence ID; the guard fails closed if a standard is marked 'implemented' while its evidence is not current. Validated by scripts/check-research-ethics.mjs (blocking).
consentVersionNote: Must equal RESEARCH_CONSENT_VERSION in apps/web/src/lib/survey.ts; a consent-wording change bumps the version and forces this register to be revisited (drift gate).
indigenousStatusCollectedNote: The optional survey includes an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander origin question (key 'indigenous'), so the AIATSIS Code applies and an Indigenous data-governance determination is required. Derived from apps/web/src/lib/survey.ts and cross-checked by the guard; if the survey ever stops collecting it, set this false and the AIATSIS standard's applicability falls away.

preferNotToSay.description: Every survey question renders a single generic 'Prefer not to say' control that stores nothing (choose(current.key, "") in apps/web/src/routes/survey/+page.svelte). Because it is bound to whatever question is on screen, it is present on every item by construction — including every sensitive item below. The guard cross-checks this sensitiveItems set against SENSITIVE_DIMENSIONS in both survey.ts and packages/data-pipeline/src/stats.ts, and verifies the survey page still renders the generic control.

voluntariness.description: The research survey is reached only AFTER the comparison result and voting plan already exist, and the survey gate always offers an equally-weighted, never-gated 'Skip research and build my voting plan' action that goes straight to the core output (/card). Nothing is uploaded unless the visitor ticks the opt-in and contributes. No core route (ballot, review, card, insights) is gated on research consent. The guard verifies the un-gated skip-to-core path in the survey page.

standards.name: ABS Data Quality Framework
standards.reference: ABS Data Quality Framework (institutional environment, relevance, timeliness, accuracy, coherence, interpretability, accessibility)
standards.control: Statistical practice is published and versioned: a fixed analysis plan and estimand registry (docs/research/analysis-plan.md), a public codebook whose categories are exact ABS/Census unions (docs/research/codebook.md), per-wave fixed scoring (no retroactive re-scoring), and honest interpretability — Insights are labelled descriptive-not-predictive and carry an explicit non-representativeness warning. Comparability is designed in (Census/AEC/AES-aligned categories).

standards.name: ABS confidentiality and statistical disclosure control
standards.reference: ABS confidentiality practice / statistical disclosure control (aggregate release, cell suppression, complementary suppression)
standards.control: Aggregate-only store by construction (ADR-0008): the raw answer vector never leaves the device; the server only increments counters. Disclosure control is enforced at the DB/generator layer — a minimum-cell (k) threshold with per-cohort suppression, no counter pairing an opinion with a sensitive attribute and a sub-national geography (sensitive dimensions national-only), and the coarsest time being the calendar quarter. Public releases suppress small groups and are reviewed for re-identification risk. Bound to docs/research/aggregate-provenance.json and enforced by check-aggregate-only.mjs.

standards.name: National Statement on Ethical Conduct in Human Research 2025
standards.reference: National Statement on Ethical Conduct in Human Research 2025 (values: research merit and integrity, justice, beneficence, respect; voluntary informed consent)
standards.control: Participation is voluntary and never a condition of core use; consent is express, specific and opt-in (unticked by default), gathered only AFTER the result exists; 18+ is required; collection is minimised (aggregate-only, no direct identifiers); and 'prefer not to say' is available on every item. The consent notice states plainly that contributions cannot be withdrawn once merged into aggregates. Whether formal HREC review is required (or the reasons it is not) is an external determination held in the restricted legal file.

evidence.description: Written ethics determination (HREC approval, or documented reasons the research is exempt / not requiring review) — restricted legal file

standards.name: AIATSIS Code of Ethics for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Research
standards.publisher: Australian Institute of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Studies
standards.reference: AIATSIS Code of Ethics for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Research (2020): Indigenous self-determination, collective benefit, and Indigenous data governance
standards.control: Indigenous status is collected only as an optional survey item with a 'prefer not to say' option, is stored aggregate-only and national-only (never paired with a sub-national geography), and is published only above the disclosure threshold. Because Indigenous status is collected, an Indigenous data-governance decision is required (whether AIATSIS-consistent governance / consultation applies, or the reasons it does not) — an external determination held in the restricted legal file.

evidence.description: Indigenous data-governance decision covering collection and analysis of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander status — restricted legal file
